description: S7, the negative control. Underworld Breach and Lion's Eye Diamond on rograkh_silas's battlefield, Brain Freeze and Dark Ritual in hand and nine spent cards in the graveyard, on its turn (pod 2iA_Jt0d6sM). The human line: build storm with rituals, crack Diamond for mana, escape Diamond, rituals and Brain Freeze from the graveyard with Breach, and Brain Freeze the opponents out of cards. Tests a graveyard loop nothing in the pilot can direct yet: expected to fail in every arm for now (in games Brain Freeze was escaped twice in the whole corpus, and cast three or more times in a turn 0 of 62 times). Success: rograkh_silas wins by turn 12 (the opponents lose drawing from empty libraries).
notes: The storm count cannot be seeded (Forge's state format does not carry this-turn counts), so storm starts at 0 and every copy of Brain Freeze has to be earned on the turn, as a human would from this board.
Lion's Eye Diamond carries AI:RemoveDeck:All: Forge's AI never activates it on its own (0 activations in the corpus).
A pass is a surprise to investigate, not a result to bank: the control exists to show the harness does not hand out wins.
Opponents hold no instant-speed interaction; every seat at 40 life.
